verdict.rationale: Simular is a computer-use agent, so consuming MCP servers is a fair axis, but the evidence never shows it acting as an MCP client. The only MCP evidence is the `@simular-ai/sai-mcp` server, which lets other coding agents drive Sai; that is the opposite role and does not count here. The generic 'custom integrations and tooling' line and skills support are adjacent features, not MCP client support.
